notes: HVS3: linked to the Edelmann et al. (2005) unbound HVS candidate discovery (T:p1-b9, T:p12-b13) and discussed as the only known HVS candidate associated with the LMC centre (T:p12-b13, T:p14-b1); included as follow-up. S5-HVS1: discussed as a known confirmed GC HVS (T:p14-b2) and included as follow-up; no Gaia source identifier is supplied in the material. The paper's terminology note at T:p2-b5 uses HVS broadly for MBH-ejected stars regardless of ejection velocity, so labels alone were not treated as proof of unboundness; inclusion rests on the prior unbound-HVS/confirmed-HVS identifications. The 12 MMT HVS candidates at T:p14-b3 are not individually named or otherwise identified, and the simulated HVS populations are not individual stars, so they are not listed.

HVS3: HVS3 is described as an 8 ± 1 M_sun star. The paper states HVS3 lacks a reliable Gaia parallax and does not appear in the Gaia subsample with published radial velocities, so no parallax or radial-velocity value is retained. The ~870 km/s value discussed for HVS3 is an ejection velocity relative to the LMC centre, not a Galactic-rest-frame total speed.

S5-HVS1: At T:p14-b2 the paper reports S5-HVS1 at α = 343.7°, δ = -51.2°. It also gives G = 16.0, an estimated ejection velocity v_ej ≃ 1800 km s^-1, and t_flight ≃ 4.8 Myr, but these are not present-day astrometric quantities requested here; the paper states S5-HVS1 lacks a reliable parallax and radial-velocity measurement. The ejection velocity is not adopted as a present-day Galactic rest-frame speed.
